Prior 1942-server-test/16-skip, 18-website-test and 37-installer-fixture results remain source-bound to the unchanged runtime inputs; they were not rerun for this evidence-only update.
Native Docker cleanup remains bound to its frozen runner. The independently audited process identities establish only the scoped TabMaster shutdown result.
No browser/backend integration, Steam CEF, library-tab editing, real Frame, wearer/controller or release proof.
